messages:
Alex Kim: Anyone up for pickup soccer this Friday at 6pm? field at the park is free per parks site :soccer:
Maya Lin: would love to — can we do 5:30 instead? earlier is better for me
Samir Gupta: I'm in if it's 6, 5:30 is tough. also can we confirm there's enough lights? last time it got muddy
Priya Patel: I'm down either way. I can bring extra cones and bibs. @Alex Kim can you DM the park permit?
Alex Kim: I can do 6 then. @Maya Lin and @Samir Gupta if 6 works i'll book a slot on the company calendar and message the Parks office
Maya Lin: ok 6 works
Samir Gupta: fine w/6, thanks Priya for cones
Jerry-bot: Reminder: company pickup events must follow office safety policy, please fill the waiver: https://redwood.example/waiver
Alex Kim: thanks bot, will post waiver link in thread and add to calendar invite
Maya Lin: quick poll — who can bring a spare ball? :raised_hand:
Priya Patel: I can
Samir Gupta: I have one tucked in my trunk
Alex Kim: awesome. see you Friday! :soccer:
